subject.title: fix(models): make nested modelPolicy wildcards match by segment boundary

question: Should previously accepted whitespace-normalized `modelPolicy.allow` refs remain supported through parser normalization, or should maintainers approve an intentional breaking validation change with a doctor migration?
rationale: This is a persisted configuration compatibility decision: the repository policy requires migration support when a changed config contract invalidates existing user files, while the permanent accepted syntax is maintainer-owned.

options.title: Preserve normalization
options.body: Normalize segment boundaries consistently with existing model-reference behavior and add regression coverage for spaced policy refs.

options.title: Approve strict validation with migration
options.body: Reject the previously tolerated form only with explicit upgrade documentation and a tested `openclaw doctor --fix` migration.

recommendation.title: Preserve normalization
recommendation.body: Normalize segment boundaries consistently with existing model-reference behavior and add regression coverage for spaced policy refs.

likelyOwner.reason: They own the active implementation and can clarify the intended configuration contract before maintainer approval.
